The manual per-link actions are what I want for both features; I don’t want every saved link automatically copied or sent to the Internet Archive.

For the real version, “Save a copy” should create a self-contained local HTML file for a normal page, while a PDF address should store the original PDF. “Update copy” should replace that preserved copy and update its date. The Internet Archive link should appear only after the service confirms that a snapshot exists; if either operation fails, show a clear error and leave the bookmark otherwise unchanged.

I’m comfortable recording the actual page storage and Internet Archive connection as a separate follow-up cycle. The simulated experience is enough to approve the intended behavior, but cycle 1 should not imply those buttons perform real preservation.
